title: A variational eigenvalue solver on a photonic quantum processor
problem_summary: Introduces the VQE algorithm itself: state preparation via a small parameterized ansatz plus classical outer-loop optimization, replacing deep coherent evolution. Demonstrated on the HeH+ (helium hydride cation) ground-state energy.

components.notes: Smallest nontrivial molecular test case for the original VQE demonstration.

components.family_or_name: small parameterized variational ansatz (pre-UCC-standardization VQE proposal)
components.notes: The paper proposes the VQE method itself; the specific ansatz used is small and photonic-hardware-native rather than a later-standardized UCCSD circuit.
Classical outer-loop optimizer for the variational parameters.
Physical platform is photonic, not superconducting/trapped-ion -- notable for cross-hardware comparison.

workflow_composition_notes: Original VQE loop: prepare a parameterized trial state on the photonic processor, measure the energy expectation value, classically update parameters via Nelder-Mead, repeat to convergence.
unknown_or_ambiguous_fields: exact_ansatz_circuit_depth: not extracted from abstract-level review; would need full-text figure inspection
qubit_mapping: not confirmed (photonic encoding differs from standard qubit JW/parity mapping conventions used by later superconducting-hardware VQE papers)
